title: The Insider Reveals Himself
next_chapter_hook: The Outer Sect Elder's blood dyed the blue stone ground crimson. Using his last ounce of strength, he hoarsely shouted a name—Ling Yuan. At that moment, a flicker of understanding flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. The chess game had finally entered a new phase.

text.content: The frigid night wind stirred the torches outside the Tianqing Sect Council Hall. Su Qingyao stood in the shadows, her fingertips caressing the warm jade pendant in her palm. From the corner of her eye, Chen Ji's profile appeared cold and iron-like. She had never seen him wear such an expression—it was not anger, but a terrifying calm, as if everything in heaven and earth had already been calculated onto his chessboard. Alarm bells rang in her heart: What was this waste of a junior brother planning to do?

At the third watch of the midnight hour, the Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfurled within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. Golden characters writhed like living creatures, presenting every movement within the sect tonight. His gaze pierced through layers of mist, landing on Outer Sect Elder Zhou Dehai—the man was furtively packing his belongings, and a transmission talisman ignited with firelight, splitting into three directives flying in different directions. A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips: As expected, the remnants of the Five Elders haven't been exterminated.

The visions from the Tianji Record surged like a tide. Chen Ji "saw" all of Zhou Dehai's secrets over the past decade: On the night before the Five Elders' destruction, this man personally sold the locations of three core disciples to the Demonic Path in exchange for a bag of spirit stones and a survival talisman; he secretly swapped sect elixirs, substituting worthless pills for the illegitimate disciples; and tonight, he was preparing to flee to the Northern Territory amid the chaos of the Great Purge to rendezvous with Holy Sect operatives. The final image froze on a token bearing a symbol Chen Ji knew intimately: Ling Yuan's private seal.

dialogue.content: (Whispering) Elder Zhou, so late at night, where are you headed?

text.content: Outer Sect Elder Zhou Dehai froze, his bundle nearly slipping from his hands. He spun around to find Chen Ji had somehow appeared at the courtyard gate, moonlight stretching his gaunt silhouette long and thin. Forcing composure, he snorted coldly: "Chen Ji? A servant disciple roaming about at this hour instead of staying in the woodshed? What brings you to the Elder's courtyard?" Yet the fleeting panic flickering in his eyes did not escape Chen Ji's notice.

dialogue.content: (Approaching slowly) The disciple couldn't sleep, so I came out for a stroll. Never expected to encounter an elder packing luggage in the dead of night—could you be planning a journey? Makes sense, with the Great Purge imminent, one would be foolish not to flee.

text.content: Zhou Dehai's expression shifted abruptly, the flying sword in his sleeve secretly unsheathing three inches. Glancing around to confirm they were alone, he grew composed, a sinister smile forming: "Chen Ji, who do you think you are? A mere waste. Even if I kill you here tonight, the sect will only assume you—a menial servant—fell and died yourself. Your good-for-nothing master couldn't even protect you, so what makes you think you can contend with me?" Murderous intent blazed in his eyes as Foundation Building Late Stage pressure descended upon Chen Ji like a mountain.

choice.prompt: Zhou Dehai, confident in his advantage and murderous intent exposed, presented Chen Ji with a critical decision—expose his crimes on the spot, or maintain composure and scheme in the shadows?

choices.description: Skip the pleasantries with this waste, directly deploy the Tianji Record to project Zhou Dehai's decade of crimes, exposing his insider identity before all sect elders. High risk, may alert the enemy, but the impact would be most stunning.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes 3 minutes of Tianji Record's foresight residual, may expose part of his abilities
choices.visible_reward: Publicly humiliate Zhou Dehai, Reputation +5, deter the Five Elders' remnants
choices.risk_hint: May cause the mastermind Ling Yuan to become alert prematurely

text.content: A sharp glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as the Tianji Record Fragment shuddered violently within his Mental Sea. No longer concealing himself, a faint golden glow manifested in his palm. Coldly he spoke: "Since Elder Zhou is in such a hurry to leave, perhaps the entire sect should send you off—" The golden light erupted, and a illusory image gradually unfurled in mid-air, displaying all of Zhou Dehai's illicit transactions and betrayals over the past decade.

choices.description: Let him leave first, secretly inform Su Qingyao to ambush him at a strategic choke point, securing both the criminal and evidence. Low risk, allows tracing connections to uncover more insiders, though gratification will be delayed.
choices.visible_cost: Requires time to set up, may allow Zhou Dehai's accomplices to escape
choices.visible_reward: Net them all in one sweep, trace connections to uncover more insider networks
choices.risk_hint: If the plan has gaps, Zhou Dehai may become desperate and act rashly

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his gaze, concealing the sharp light in his eyes. He stepped back, assuming a fearful demeanor, stammering: "D-Disciple misspoke, Elder Zhou, please forgive me..." Zhou Dehai snorted dismissively and swept off. Little did he know that every move he made had already been relayed to Su Qingyao by Chen Ji through a voice-transmitting jade slip.

choices.description: Deliberately provoke Zhou Dehai, force him to reveal more trump cards and accomplices,顺便probe whether there's an even greater figure behind him. Highest risk, but potential rewards are also greatest.
choices.visible_cost: May suffer physical pain, and provoking the opponent makes the situation harder to control
choices.visible_reward: Uncover Zhou Dehai's complete network of connections, even reaching direct evidence against Ling Yuan
choices.risk_hint: If the other party directly strikes to kill, there might not be time to react

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile appearing especially chilling under the moonlight: "Elder Zhou, the one backing you behind the scenes... couldn't possibly be Sect Master Ling Yuan, right? Otherwise, where would you get such confidence?" Zhou Dehai's pupils contracted sharply, and he blurted out unconsciously: "How do you know—" Halfway through the words, he abruptly stopped, fear flickering in his eyes.

Zhou Dehai's face turned ashen, knowing he had slipped up. The aura of Foundation Building Late Stage erupted as he slapped toward Chen Ji's chest, spiritual energy surging like a tide: "Boy, you know too much!" Before the palm wind arrived, Chen Ji already felt his internal organs almost crushed out of shape. But he still didn't dodge—because he was gambling, gambling that Zhou Dehai wouldn't dare to openly kill someone inside the sect.

dialogue.content: (A cold voice sliced through the night sky) Elder Zhou, what tremendous fury! Striking a servant disciple so severely—does this mean our Tianqing Sect has no rules?

text.content: Su Qingyao, dressed in pure white, resembled a celestial maiden under the moonlight as she landed on the courtyard wall. Behind her followed more than ten disciples from the Law Enforcement Hall, their spiritual light chains gleaming with a cold, forbidding radiance. Zhou Dehai's expression shifted dramatically, his palm's momentum faltering. He surveyed his surroundings and found all escape routes completely sealed. Chen Ji slowly wiped away the blood at the corner of his mouth, raising his head to offer Su Qingyao an innocent smile: "Senior Sister Su, you've arrived just in time. Elder Zhou seems... rather reluctant to explain the items in that bundle of his."

The law enforcement disciples forcibly opened the bundle, revealing sect secret jade slips, over a dozen medium-grade spirit stones, and a blueprint highlighting vulnerabilities in the Tianqing Sect's protective formation. Zhou Dehai's face turned deathly pale as his legs gave way, collapsing to the ground. Su Qingyao picked up the blueprint, her eyes flashing with a cold, piercing light: "Conspiring with external enemies, leaking formation secrets... Zhou Dehai, do you understand this is a crime punishable by sect annihilation?"

dialogue.content: (Speaking calmly) Senior Sister Su, this isn't even the worst of it. Ask him whether the three core disciples who disappeared ten years ago were sold by him?

choice.prompt: Evidence is conclusive, Zhou Dehai has become a trapped turtle. How should this be dealt with?

choices.description: Take the opportunity to force Zhou Dehai to confess all his co-conspirators' names, sweeping up the remnants of the Five Elders faction.
choices.visible_cost: Zhou Dehai might refuse to confess even unto death, and the interrogation will require time
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a complete insider list, thoroughly purge the sect's hidden dangers
choices.risk_hint: If someone overhears the news in the shadows, they might escape in advance or counterattack
choices.process_label: eyes like blades, press with questions

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward slowly, crouching before the collapsed Zhou Dehai. His voice was gentle yet cutting like a blade: "Elder Zhou, do you think Sect Master Ling Yuan knows you were planning to run tonight? If he does... then you're nothing but a discarded pawn. If he doesn't..." He paused, smiling meaningfully, "then Sect Master Ling Yuan really doesn't care much about you."

choices.description: Instead of handling this privately, directly escort him to the Council Hall for an open trial in front of all elders and disciples, maximizing the deterrence against any wrongdoers.
choices.visible_cost: The commotion is too great, which might provoke Ling Yuan's direct intervention
choices.visible_reward: Reputation soars, everyone in the sect will know Chen Ji's name
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan might intervene publicly to protect Zhou Dehai, causing the situation to deadlock

text.content: The Law Enforcement Bell rang thunderously, eighteen tolls echoing across the Tianqing Sect's skies. Moments later, the Council Hall blazed with lights as dozens of elders gathered. Chen Ji personally escorted Zhou Dehai into the hall, announcing loudly: "Disciple Chen Ji captured the insider Zhou Dehai tonight. This person conspired with the Demonic Path, leaked formations, and sold fellow disciples. Both human and material evidence are present—please, all elders, examine!"

The Council Hall erupted in an uproar. Several elders from the remnants of the Five Elders faction exchanged uncertain glances, some secretly glancing toward the main seat—where no one sat, as Ling Yuan did not attend tonight. Zhou Dehai, bound by spiritual light chains, knelt trembling in the hall's center, his whole body shaking like a sieve. The law enforcement disciples presented the material evidence one by one, each piece striking like a heavy hammer against everyone's hearts.

dialogue.content: (An aged voice came from outside the door) Who rings the Law Enforcement Bell in the middle of the night? I only entered closed seclusion for half a day, and the sect has already fallen into such chaos?

text.content: The crowd automatically parted a path. Ling Yuan, in green robes, walked in slowly. His gaze swept over the kneeling Zhou Dehai, his brow furrowing almost imperceptibly before restoring composure. Chen Ji stood to the side with lowered head, yet he acutely caught Ling Yuan's fingertips trembling slightly within his sleeve—that was a sign of forcibly suppressed emotion. He sneered in his heart: Old fox, why so anxious?

dialogue.content: (Gazing around) Zhou Dehai, though gravely sinful, did render service to the sect. This matter... shall be deliberated later.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan attempts to shield Zhou Dehai, downplaying the major incident. Everyone is waiting for a response; Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.description: Confront Ling Yuan on the spot about why he is protecting the sect insider, making the conflict public. Extreme risk; may bring disaster upon oneself, but if successful, will completely sever all ties.
choices.visible_cost: Sever ties with Ling Yuan directly; future circumstances will be extremely difficult.
choices.visible_reward: Completely expose the relationship between Ling Yuan and the sect insider, winning support from the sect's justice faction.
choices.risk_hint: Without ironclad evidence, Ling Yuan may turn the tables and accuse you of defaming the sect master.

text.content: Chen Ji does not flinch, locking eyes with Ling Yuan: "The sect master says to discuss this later. May I ask what there is to discuss? Is it Zhou Dehai's crime of secretly communing with the Demonic Path, or the responsibility of the person behind him?" At these words, a deathly silence descends upon the Council Hall. Ling Yuan's expression changes abruptly, then returns to normal, though a cold murderous intent has already flickered in his eyes.

choices.description: Temporarily endure, expressing that everything will be decided by the sect master. But secretly preserve evidence, waiting for a better opportunity.
choices.visible_cost: Zhou Dehai might receive lenient punishment, emboldening the sect insider's arrogance.
choices.visible_reward: Make Ling Yuan lower his guard, preserving strength while awaiting a greater opportunity.
choices.risk_hint: May disappoint supporters, reducing their trust in you.

text.content: Chen Ji bows respectfully: "Your disciple was presumptuous; I leave everything to the sect master's judgment." In his lowered eyes, a flash of mockery glimmers. Ling Yuan nods, about to announce the decision, when Zhou Dehai suddenly bursts into mad laughter—bitter and desperate.

Zhou Dehai's laughter cuts off abruptly. He violently breaks free from the chains, spiritual energy surging frantically within him—it is self-destruction! "You think this old man wanted to be a dog?" His eyes fix on Ling Yuan like a madman. "Ling Yuan! You used this old man for ten years, and now that things have failed, you discard the pawn to save yourself? Even as a ghost, I will not let you—" Before the words finish, a golden light shoots from Chen Ji's sleeve, precisely sealing Zhou Dehai's meridian points, stopping the self-destruction.

dialogue.content: (Softly) Want to die? Not so easily. Tell me everything you know, and perhaps you may keep your body whole.

text.content: Zhou Dehai's meridians are completely severed, his breath like a gossamer thread. Using his last ounce of strength, he hoarsely shouts out a name—"Ling Yuan!" The sound echoes through the Council Hall like thunder. Ling Yuan's face turns ashen, his hands within his sleeves clenched into fists. Su Qingyao steps forward, blocking Chen Ji, her gaze sweeping vigilantly over Ling Yuan. And Chen Ji merely stands there quietly, a faint smile curving at the corner of his lips—he has waited for this moment far too long.

Absolute silence fills the Council Hall. Several elders of the Five Elders' remnant faction look ashen, some already quietly retreating. Ling Yuan surveys the surroundings, saying coldly: "This person speaks nonsense at death's door; none of you should take it seriously. Guards, drag this mad thief away—" Yet no one moves. Everyone's gaze falls on Chen Ji, waiting for this servant disciple who rose to fame overnight to respond. And Chen Ji merely tilts his head slightly, saying softly to Su Qingyao: "Senior Sister, may we speak privately?"

Su Qingyao gazes into Chen Ji's profound eyes like an abyss, suddenly understanding something. She nods, turning to the crowd: "Tonight's incident will be thoroughly investigated by the Law Enforcement Hall. Esteemed elders, please return; tomorrow will bring a just verdict." Only after the crowd disperses does she whisper: "You knew this would happen?" Chen Ji offers no answer, only raising his gaze toward where Ling Yuan departed, his eyes dark as ink. The chess game has reached its middle phase; the true contest is only beginning.
